avis.titre: The Best Pimple Patches to Go Out
avis.texte: Best pimple patches I’ve used to go out! I usually use them to go out because they are pretty expensive for the quantity that you’re getting. They’re other cheap pimple patches that I use that are called Liva Clean Pimple Patches. I would recommend these when being at home and you want to save as much Knemo Pimples Patches as possible. The Liva Clean Pimple Patches come in three different sizes I think and the quantity and quality are very good compared to other pimple patches I have tried in the past. Their quantity is 330 pimples patches. The only thing that I think needs to be added to the Knemo pimple patches are different sizes and more pimple patches lol. They do become noticeable after about 4 hours, but that is how you know that the pimple patch is ready to be removed and replaced. They also stick on pretty well. Make sure that you get the whole pimple patch on your skin because if you leave a little part of it that isn’t sticking to your skin it will come off when you do your skincare. I 100% recommend these!

avis.titre: Invisible, Effective & Perfect for Daytime Wear!Invisible, Effective & Perfect for Daytime Wear!
avis.texte: I am SO impressed with the Knemo Thincognito Acne Pimple Patches! These are hands down some of the most discreet patches I’ve ever used. They’re ultra-thin (true to the name!) and blend seamlessly into my skin, so I can actually wear them during the day — even under makeup — without anyone noticing. What really sold me is how effective they are. I’ve used them on whiteheads and early-stage breakouts, and they noticeably reduce redness and swelling overnight. By morning, the patch has absorbed all the gunk and the pimple looks flatter and less angry. It also helps prevent me from picking, which is a huge bonus. They stick really well but don’t irritate my skin when I remove them. No pulling, no redness — just clean, protected skin. If you want something that works AND stays low-key, these are 100% worth it. I always keep a pack in my skincare drawer (and my bag, just in case). Total game changer! ✨

I rarely have breakouts and even less getting older. But I had a difficult spot on the side of my mouth/chin and it would just not go away. I had noticed the younger folks I work with using the dots, but theirs were either stars or characters. I ran across a similar product on IG and so I ordered these due to them being clear/invisible. I used them 2 or 3 times at night. Took care of it!

avis.titre: Niceee & affordable no pimples left behind
avis.texte: Brings everything to the surface, leave it on and let it do its job. No scars
Loveeee these pimpie(pimple) patches. They work better than any other patch that I have tried.
The stickiness is pretty good. It doesn’t peel with time. Very easy to put on and does its job. It’s not that thick, but it does show a bit on my skin.

I liked these patches way more than I expected. They stick really well overnight even if I’m moving around in my sleep, and they don’t lift at the edges the way a lot of cheaper ones do. I used one on a whitehead that was starting to get irritated and by the morning it pulled out way more gunk than I thought it would. They also sit flat enough that I could wear one under makeup during the day without it showing. They feel gentle on my skin and never leave that weird sticky ring behind. I’ll definitely keep the pack around for emergencies.

These are so sticky and thin, I could barely see it on my face! It is also very sticky and did not lift after I put my skincare on the rest of my face. After a day of having it on, it sucked all the gunk out of my pimple.
It's super transparent which I prefer. It simply hides well under makeup too! I think it works well compared to other brands out there

I'm not sure why others are complaining about the sticker or don't understand it. To me that's the whole thing that sets these apart from basic pimple patches. I placed one on my leg to show you exactly how the stickers work. When removing it from the sheet, make sure to pull away the strip from the back or the patch may separate from the sticker. The side with the blue arrow is sticky to hold the patch to the sticker. The pink side is where you want to hold and pull from when you're ready to take the sticker off. So place the patch while holding on either side of the arrows. Once placed pull up from the pink side and the sticker is removed but the patch stays behind. When you're applying a pimple patch the last thing you want is oils from your fingers sticking to the patch, then sealing said oils in with the pimple you're trying to get rid of...kinda defeats the purpose! So to me, these stickers are an ingenius idea to applying sanitary, oil free patches. The patches themselves work great. They reduce the pimple overnight, they stay in place, and are hardly visible so you can wear them out of the house if you'd like. The price is very reasonable, especially considering the sticker eliminates contaminates from being placed on your pimple/skin!!

These patches cost a little more than others I’ve used but I am impressed with the quality. The patches are nearly invisible and do a nice job of softening the look of my blemishes when they are applied. It doesn’t totally conceal them but they are certainly less noticeable. The two piece application system works well and makes them a little easier to put on, cleaner too I suppose. They stayed on my face through the night, I’m very pleased.

These are fantastic! They work, are super thin and very easy to put on. I especially like that they come in 2 different sizes so you have an option if your breakouts are bigger. These are some of the easiest to remove from the packaging, they just peel right off. They lasted all day for me, I even put makeup on top and had no issues with them losing stickiness.

These are all the same size. I like this smaller size I think it’s perfect for most blemishes. You get a lot in the pack. And price is fair. I do prefer the ones with cuter designs but these work well.

avis.titre: Skincare that is Hard to Beat!

They are easy to use and apply, effectively managing and controlling stubborn imperfections. They are the premium version of the numerous patches available throughout Amazon. They also feature a two part process, that provides more effective care! Highly recommended!

These pimple patch do look invisible They were easy to put on with the dotted lines to rip in the back. However, I'm not sure why there are stickers on top of the patch. It didn't help with anything and was instead an extra step to take care of before application.
